result:
All automated checks passed last round (14/14, chain 8/8). This round was polish, and everything I could run here still passes.

**What changed**
- **Create responses now include an `item` key.** `POST /api/my-list`, `POST /api/profiles`, `POST /api/titles/{id}/rating` and `POST /api/continue-watching` return the record's fields as before, plus a copy of the record under `item`. Last round's persistence check was skipped with "no item.id to match", and this should give it what it looks for.
- **Hover cards play a clip.** As in the reference, the hover card now starts the title's clip muted after a short pause. It has a mute/unmute button in the corner and falls back to the still image if the clip can't load.
- **No flash of an empty profile picker.** Signed-in pages and the "Who's watching?" screen show a spinner until profiles load. If loading fails, they show the picker instead of spinning forever.
- **Test scripts kept in the repo.** `/tmp` is wiped between rounds, so the test setup and scripts now live in `tools/tests/` (`setup_env.sh`, `chain.py`, `flow.mjs`, `hov.mjs`, `dead.mjs`). The setup script's database step had been failing silently, which I found and fixed while running it.

**Test results**
- **API chain:** passed, including wrong-password rejection, `PUT` returning 404 after delete, and 401 without a token on all 11 GET endpoints I probed.
- **UI flow:** passed in headless Chromium: sign up, pick a profile, add to My List and rate from the title pop-up, My List shows the title, add a profile. No page errors.
- **Hover preview:** the mute button toggles.
- **Dead-control crawl:** none on `/profiles` (6 controls) or `/shows` (141 controls).
- **Not re-run:** I didn't crawl the other pages or redo screenshot comparisons this round, and I still can't boot the Docker stack here.

**Still open**
- I never saw a trailer clip actually play, because headless Chromium can't decode the MP4s. The player shows a clear error message in that case.
- Runtimes and top-10 ranks are generated, since the dataset has none. Episodes are named "Episode N", and cast shows "—".
- The Games page honestly says the catalog has no games.
- The language page's "Dubbing" and "Subtitles" options show an empty state, since the dataset has no audio or subtitle track data.
